own_solution.law: Sequential exponential attenuation gives I_out/I_0 = exp[-mu_c t_c - mu_Pb t_Pb] = 1/F. Therefore t_Pb = [ln(F) - mu_c t_c]/mu_Pb. Using t_c = 0.30 m gives [ln(10000) - 15(0.30)]/80 m.
assumptions: The explicitly stated exponential attenuation model applies to both materials.
All thicknesses are converted to metres when used with coefficients in inverse metres.
The earlier-shield additions do not change the present shield.
The shed roof remains outside the beam path.

notes: I disagree with the pass-1 minimal-pair finding after inspecting the claims: TC013 and TD827 are explicitly identified as numeral-free controls, not claimed to preserve their twins' numerical values. Their stated transformation accurately describes the wording. Both expressly claimed numerical minimal pairs preserve 7.7 cm and change the attachment as intended. Adding q cm to the present concrete wall gives t_Pb = 5.887925465 - (15/80)q cm, yielding 5.08168, 4.44418 and 3.75043 cm for q = 4.3, 7.7 and 11.4 cm, respectively. All certified answers agree with these calculations. The unshielded intensity cancels for every listed positive intensity. The symbolic governing relations are consistent when thickness units are converted; all listed concrete additions leave a positive required lead thickness.
